note: Evidence-linked team spellings. Used ONLY to look a Hotspawn spelling up in an official source; every published page keeps Hotspawn's own spelling. Each entry carries the link that shows the equivalence. Nothing is mapped without a link.

WROTBERRY.note: Hotspawn lists this roster as WROTBERRY; HLTV's match page for the same Elisa BreakOut Series #2 fixture names it WBT, and the official Valve standings list WBT (rank 60, 1201 points).

RoundsGG.note: Hotspawn lists RoundsGG; HLTV's match page for the same fixture names it ROUNDS, matching the official standings entry ROUNDS (rank 310, 548 points).

PVISION.note: Hotspawn lists PVISION; HLTV's match page for the same Thunderpick fixture names it PARIVISION (PARIVISION appears in the official standings).

BB Team.note: Hotspawn lists BB Team; HLTV's match page for the same fixture names it BetBoom Team, matching the official standings entry BETBOOM.

Envy.note: Override of last resort only: HLTV's Envy roster (Maka, Lucky, misutaaa, Kursy, Graviti) is the same five players the official standings list under the earlier name 3DMAX (rank 21, 1500 points). The roster-overlap rule normally resolves this before the alias is needed.
